# Younoya

> Intentional gifting and considered keepsakes inspired by astrology. Younoya helps visitors explore meaningful objects for people, occasions and new beginnings.

## Explore

- [Coming Soon & Private Invitation](https://younoya.com/): Younoya boutique entrance and private preview invitation.
- [The Brooch Collection](https://younoya.com/shop): ten authentic handcrafted consecrated brooches with exact dimensions, weights, and displayed prices.
- [Let Younoya choose](https://younoya.com/find-a-gift): an interactive, local gift-selection preview. The current preview is not a full Vedic astrology or AI reading.
- [The Journal](https://younoya.com/blog): stories of intention, ritual and astrology-backed gifting.
